fleet.headerHint: Shippers see trucks that can carry their load. A base, a rate per km and current insurance help yours rank well.
fleet.emptyMessage: Add a truck so shippers can find it and book it.
fleet.formIntro: Fill this in as it appears on the truck and its bluebook. Fields marked * are required.
fleet.verificationChangeWarning: Changing the type, body, capacity, make, model, year, chassis or engine number takes away the verified badge until an admin checks the truck again.
fleet.registrationNumberHelper: As on the number plate and bluebook, in the zonal or provincial format.
fleet.capacityHelper: The most it carries. Heavier loads aren't matched to it.
fleet.bodySectionHint: Shippers look for the body that suits their goods, so pick the closest match.
fleet.cargoBedFieldLabel: Cargo bed inside size, in feet (optional)
fleet.baseSectionHint: Where the truck is usually parked. It ranks higher for loads picked up nearby.
fleet.noLocationList: The list of places could not be loaded. You can add the base later.
fleet.pricingSectionHint: With a rate, shippers see an asking price for every trip: the rate times the distance, never below your minimum. Without one, they make you offers.
fleet.featuresSectionHint: Shippers see these on the truck.
fleet.papersSectionHint: Bluebook, insurance and pollution test. Private: shippers only see whether the insurance is current.
fleet.bluebookUntilHelper: The yearly vehicle tax renewal, in A.D. (English calendar).
fleet.insuranceUntilHelper: In A.D. Current insurance shows shippers an Insured badge and helps the truck rank.

errors.ratePerKmFormat: Enter rupees per km, up to 1,000
